label: Candid PCS Subjects
description: A small illustrative subset of Candid's Philanthropy Classification System (PCS) Subjects facet, used to demonstrate CommonGood Atlas's classification-assignment mechanism -- NOT a reproduction of Candid's actual licensed PCS taxonomy. Real codes, hierarchy, and coverage should be imported from Candid's own published taxonomy release before this scheme is used for anything beyond illustration. affordable-housing's mapping to CommonGood's own issue-area-housing uses broadMatch, not exactMatch, since Affordable Housing is more specific than the CommonGood Housing issue area.
